value.0: Sella has dressings ready? Put the first batch on the east return path and the second on the north spur. The south switchback can wait; Lysa is already moving carts away from it.
Good. If a runner has to choose between speed and bleeding, I would like them to have a third option.
Fen sent the marker sheet? About time. The runner marks go here, here, and not there unless he wants us walking into haulers with nervous trigger fingers.
Done. Take that back to Fen before he decides a guess is good enough.
Sella has the kit count? Let me see. Fewer than I wanted, more than I feared. That is Veles arithmetic.
This will keep the next runner wave honest about what they can carry. You did well.
Sella Morn works out of the Veles shops. I need her count before I assign runners to routes.
The runner manifest is set. It will be wrong by sundown, but at least it started as the truth.
Tavia Orell watches the starport doors more than the crowd, noting every runner who comes in from the Wildlands.
I have people willing to carry food and messages, but I cannot assign them without knowing how many field kits Sella has ready. Ask her for the count and bring it back to me.
Thank you. Sella is in the shops. If she says the count is ugly, do not soften it for me.
Tavia gives the route sheet in your hands a quick look. Get Fen's marker codes settled first; I cannot build a manifest on moving ground.
I will take the priority list back to Sella.
Not yet.
